first.first_line: Video drives sales but has not paid back yet: 1.9 won of shelf sales per won over the half year against a break-even of 3.3 at 30% contribution.
first.second_line: Sustain video after the flight is past the point of profit: its last won returns about 1.5 (90%: 1.4-1.8) against 3.3. Step it down and measure it.
first.search_action: Cut generic terms 30%; brand-term test in Q3

final.first_line: The launch video pays back. Short video and online video together returned about 4.5 won of shelf sales per won over the half year (90% interval 3.9-5.1), most of it in stores. At an assumed 30% contribution on shelf sales, break-even is 3.3, and even the low end of the interval clears it.
final.second_line: Sustain video after the flight sits near the edge: its last won returns about 3.7 (90%: 3.3-4.1) against a break-even of 3.3. Hold the weight and find the edge with a step-down test.
final.search_action: Cut generic terms 30%; brand-term test in Q3

what_changed: Media budget (15.0% of sales -> 7.6%) and how fast video builds awareness. No estimator, design rule or decision rule changed.
